decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the application for the erection of a part-two storey and part one-storey side extension to the existing dwellinghouse would not be detrimental to the appearance of the existing dwelling or the character of the street scene and surrounding area. The proposal is generally consistent with the Policies ENV B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) within the Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003, and the relevant provisions of the Residential Extension Guidelines (2002). Where the proposal is not compliant, it is considered that there will be no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 5 - The garage or car parking accommodation shown on drawing number 32/NA/01/A shall be provided before the dwelling to which it relates is occupied and thereafter it shall not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles.

Condition : 6 - The window formed in the rear first floor elevation shall be obscured glazed and fixed at the bottom two panes and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 7 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side or rear wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a part two storey side and part single storey side extension to existing dwellinghouse.
